records.jp: 誰もいない駅って新鮮だなぁ
records.en_original: It's weird being in a station with no people, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: It's weird being in a station with no people, huh?
records.en: It's weird being in a station with no people, huh?

records.jp: 新鮮？　<CR>こういう時も結構ありませんか？
records.en_original: You think? I've seen it quite often actually.
records.en_auxiliary: You think? I've seen it quite often actually.
records.en: You think?<CR>I've seen it quite often actually.

records.jp: いつもラッシュの時に乗ってたから
records.en_original: It's probably 'cause I always rode the train during rush hour.
records.en_auxiliary: It's probably 'cause I always rode the train during rush hour.
records.en: It's probably 'cause I always rode the train during rush hour.

records.jp: あー、ラッシュ嫌ですよね。<CR>車両を移動しないと座れなかったりして
records.en_original: Oh, I'm not a fan of rush hour. You have to search the whole train just to find a seat.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I'm not a fan of rush hour. You have to search the whole train just to find a seat.
records.en: Ah, rush hour is unpleasant.<CR>Sometimes I had to move to another car to find a seat.

records.jp: （それはむしろ空いてる部類では？）
records.en_original: (I don't think a train where you can find a seat at all counts as rush hour...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I don't think a train where you can find a seat at all counts as rush hour...)
records.en: (Would that not count as relatively empty?)

records.jp: 気づいてなかっただけなのかも。<CR>電車待ってる時は大体スマホいじってたし
records.en_original: Maybe I just didn't notice. I'm usually on my phone while I wait for the train.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe I just didn't notice. I'm usually on my phone while I wait for the train.
records.en: Maybe I just didn't notice. I'm<CR>usually on my phone while I wait for the train.

records.jp: まぁ、そういうものですよね。<CR>わたしも単語帳とか見てましたし
records.en_original: I think most people usually are doing something while they wait. I always used the time to review vocabulary.
records.en_auxiliary: I think most people usually are doing something while they wait. I always used the time to review vocabulary.
records.en: I guess that's normal.<CR>I used to go over vocabulary cards while I waited too.

records.jp: （並列していいのかな）
records.en_original: (It's like we're a different species...)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's like we're a different species...)
records.en: (Can those really be put in the same category?)

records.jp: 星崎さん、もし、この駅が<CR>どこでも繋がってるとしたら、どこに行きたいですか？
records.en_original: If you could go anywhere you wanted using this station, where would you go?
records.en_auxiliary: If you could go anywhere you wanted using this station, where would you go?
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, if this station<CR>connected to anywhere, where would you want to go?

records.jp: すっごい大都会とか。<CR>詩帆さんが行ってたみたいな
records.en_original: Some big city somewhere. Like where you went.
records.en_auxiliary: Some big city somewhere. Like where you went.
records.en: Some huge city. Like the<CR>one you visited, Shiho-san.

records.jp: わたしもまた行く機会があれば、<CR>今度はもっとしっかり観光したいです
records.en_original: I'd love to go again if I had the chance. I didn't get to sightsee much last time.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd love to go again if I had the chance. I didn't get to sightsee much last time.
records.en: I'd love to go again if I had the chance.<CR>I didn't get to sightsee much last time.

records.jp: お買い物して、美味しいもの食べて、<CR>素敵なホテル泊まって……最強の女子会を開くとか
records.en_original: We could have the ultimate girls' day out! Shopping, a nice dinner, then stay at a fancy hotel!
records.en_auxiliary: We could have the ultimate girls' day out! Shopping, a nice dinner, then stay at a fancy hotel!
records.en: We could shop, eat delicious food,<CR>stay at a lovely hotel... and hold the ultimate girls’ trip.

records.jp: 「最強の女子会」、参加してみたいなぁ
records.en_original: I'd be there in a heartbeat.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd be there in a heartbeat.
records.en: I'd be there in a heartbeat.

records.jp: のどかな温泉地とか
records.en_original: Somewhere with hot springs.
records.en_auxiliary: Somewhere with hot springs.
records.en: Somewhere with hot springs.

records.jp: あー、なるほど。<CR>それもいいかも……
records.en_original: Ahhh, that would be nice.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahhh, that would be nice.
records.en: Ahhh, that<CR>would be nice.

records.jp: 一日中、何もしないでお部屋でくつろいで、<CR>入りたくなったら温泉に入る、とか憧れちゃいます
records.en_original: Relaxing all day in your room, and taking a dip whenever you feel like it.
records.en_auxiliary: Relaxing all day in your room, and taking a dip whenever you feel like it.
records.en: I dream of relaxing in our room all day without doing anything,<CR>then entering the hot spring whenever we feel like it.

records.jp: いいなぁ、それ。私もついてっていい？
records.en_original: That sounds awesome. Could I join you?
records.en_auxiliary: That sounds awesome. Could I join you?
records.en: That sounds awesome. Could I join you?

records.jp: ええ。行くときはぜひ誘いますね
records.en_original: Of course. I'll be sure to invite you when I go.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. I'll be sure to invite you when I go.
records.en: Of course. I'll be sure to invite you when I go.

records.jp: ……そうでした。<CR>ここだと、いくら待っても電車は来ないんですよね
records.en_original: That's right... No matter how long we wait, a train isn't coming.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right... No matter how long we wait, a train isn't coming.
records.en: That's right...<CR>No matter how long we wait, a train isn't coming.

records.jp: 車窓眺めるの、結構好きだったんですけどね
records.en_original: I always loved watching the scenery go by from the window.
records.en_auxiliary: I always loved watching the scenery go by from the window.
records.en: I always loved watching the scenery go by from the window.

records.jp: わかる。いいよね
records.en_original: Me too.
records.en_auxiliary: Me too.
records.en: Me too.

records.jp: ぼーっとできて
records.en_original: Just spacing out, watching everything whizz by.
records.en_auxiliary: Just spacing out, watching everything whizz by.
records.en: Just spacing out, watching everything whizz by.

records.jp: ええ。ずっと景色見てると、<CR>悩み事とか色んな事が薄くなっていって
records.en_original: Yes. I can feel my troubles melt away as I watch.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. I can feel my troubles melt away as I watch.
records.en: Yes. I can feel my<CR>troubles melt away as I watch.

records.jp: その街に流れる空気になった気がしませんか？<CR>自分から一旦離れたみたいな
records.en_original: It starts to feel like you become one with the city after a while, don't you think? Like you leave yourself for a little bit.
records.en_auxiliary: It starts to feel like you become one with the city after a while, don't you think? Like you leave yourself for a little bit.
records.en: Don't you start to feel like you've become part of that town's atmosphere?<CR>Like you've stepped away from yourself for a while.

records.jp: そういう時間って大事だよね
records.en_original: That kind of thing is nice to feel every now and again.
records.en_auxiliary: That kind of thing is nice to feel every now and again.
records.en: That kind of thing is nice to feel every now and again.

records.jp: ここでも景色は変わらなくても、<CR>海の向こうを眺めたりできますけどね
records.en_original: The scenery might not change, but we can still enjoy the view of the water from here.
records.en_auxiliary: The scenery might not change, but we can still enjoy the view of the water from here.
records.en: The scenery might not change, but we can<CR>still enjoy the view of the water from here.

records.jp: うん。ゆっくりしていこう
records.en_original: Yeah. Let's take it easy.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Let's take it easy.
records.en: Yeah. Let's take it easy.

records.jp: 動かなくても景色変わって。楽だよねー。
records.en_original: It's crazy that we can go to different places and see different scenery without moving ourselves.
records.en_auxiliary: It's crazy that we can go to different places and see different scenery without moving ourselves.
records.en: The scenery changes without us even moving. It's so convenient.

records.jp: 散歩は足が疲れちゃいますもんね。電車なら<CR>何もしなくても、乗っていれば目的地に着きますけど
records.en_original: Walking is quite tiring. With trains, all we have to do is stand for a few minutes and we've arrived.
records.en_auxiliary: Walking is quite tiring. With trains, all we have to do is stand for a few minutes and we've arrived.
records.en: Walking makes your legs tired. On a train,<CR>you reach your destination simply by riding it.

records.jp: この学校も、電車でまわれたらいいのに
records.en_original: If only there was a train that could take us around school.
records.en_auxiliary: If only there was a train that could take us around school.
records.en: If only there was a train that could take us around school.

records.jp: あはは、それくらいは歩きましょうよ
records.en_original: Ahaha, I think we can at least walk that much.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, I think we can at least walk that much.
records.en: Ahaha, I think we can at least walk that much.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
